instruction: Open https://tidesandcurrents.noaa.gov/met.html?id=8724580. Request hourly observed wind speed, direction and gust records at Key West for September 12-13 2025, metric units and GMT. Use the Meteorological Observations page, select 1 hr and Data Only. Other weather products may load alongside wind; an air-temperature or pressure request alone does not complete the task. The outcome is initiation of the correctly configured observation-data request; a saved file is not required. Use Data Only to initiate the JSON observation-data request.
